title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・盾の重さ

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Phew… That parade wasn't exactly elegant…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O is so fast and strong… Not to mention that hill…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It felt so much steeper than usual… My legs felt paralyzed from the pressure…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So this is a long-distance G1 race… This is the spring Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well done to you, Doto. Your performance as my guide was satisfactory.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But you mustn't forget, should you wish to run by my side, this year's repertoire will be replete with arduous paths, much like in today's experience.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, I u-understand… I promise to be more diligent next time!
She solemnly swears to improve herself. Keeping up with T.M. Opera O on the road ahead won't be an easy feat.
